summary: Verified MongoDB Atlas connectivity and Vercel serverless entry boot for Lux.Sex. 6/6 backend tests passed in 17.7s. Atlas M0 cluster (horoscopo.hmts3pj.mongodb.net) is reachable after 0.0.0.0/0 network access fix; server_info returns version, write/read/delete round-trip on luxsex.test_connectivity works. /app/api/index.py imports cleanly with MONGO_URL/DB_NAME injected via env (no changes to /app/backend/.env). Uvicorn on spare port against Atlas seeds banners on startup and GET /api/banners returns the seeded list (no _id leak). Local preview backend regression green: GET /api/ 200 and GET /api/horoscope/daily?sign=aries&lang=pt returns application/json.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_<uuid> doc in luxsex.test_connectivity (deleted in same test). Banner seed ran once on Atlas via ephemeral uvicorn startup — persists on Atlas cluster.
test_credentials: Atlas URI + DB used exactly as provided in review request; no admin key needed (only GET /api/banners exercised).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_atlas.py can be re-run any time to re-verify Atlas + Vercel entry. It never mutates /app/backend/.env and does not restart supervisor. Vercel URL was intentionally not tested (deployment not yet performed). If banner docs on Atlas need cleanup, drop luxsex.banners collection.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously SSL handshake failure (TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR) was caused by the Atlas Network Access list not including the client IP. After user allowed 0.0.0.0/0, TLS + SRV resolution succeed and the FastAPI app boots and serves against Atlas without further code changes.
